title: Ayurvedic Complex
body_html:
Ayurvedic Complex is a carefully crafted blend of time-honored herbs inspired by the principles of Ayurveda. Featuring Ashwagandha, Turmeric, and Holy Basil, this supplement supports overall well-being by helping the body maintain balance and resilience. These ingredients work together to promote a sense of harmony, making it an excellent addition to your daily wellness routine.


This unique formula combines digestive-supporting herbs like Triphala and Trikatu with adaptogenic botanicals such as Brahmi and Shilajit. Turmeric, known for its active compounds, is complemented by black pepper extract to support optimal absorption. Additionally, ingredients like cinnamon, cloves, and garlic contribute to a well-rounded herbal blend rooted in ancient traditions.


Designed for those seeking a conscious approach to wellness, Ayurvedic Complex provides a convenient way to incorporate traditional herbal wisdom into modern lifestyles. Whether used as part of a daily self-care practice or alongside mindful nutrition, this supplement supports vitality and balance in a holistic way.*


Ingredients: Ashwagandha Root (2.5% extract), Turmeric Root (95% extract), Cinnamon Bark Powder (Cinnamomum wilsonii), Holy Basil Leaf (2% extract), Garlic Bulb (1% extract), Trikatu Powder (consisting of black pepper fruit powder, long pepper fruit powder, and ginger root powder), Triphala Powder (consisting of amla fruit powder [Phyllanthus emblica], bibhitaki fruit powder [Terminalia bellirica], and haritaki fruit powder [Terminalia chebula]), Amla Fruit Powder, Sandalwood Wood Powder (Pterocarpus soyauxii), Cloves Bud Powder, Celery Seed Powder, Licorice Root Powder, Brahmi Leaves (20% extract) (Bacopa monnieri), Shilajit, Cordyceps (mycelium), Lavender Powder (whole plant), Peppermint Leaf Powder, Hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, Vegetable magnesium stearate, Silicon dioxide.

Manufacturer's country: USA

Product amount: 60 capsules / 2.22 oz / 0.14 lb / 63 g

Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 2.88 oz / 0.18 lbs / 82 g

Suggested use: Take 1 capsule daily preferably with a meal or as directed by a healthcare professional.

Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement. This product is manufactured and packaged in a facility which may also process milk, soy, wheat, egg, peanuts, tree nuts, fish and crustacean shellfish. KEEP OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.



*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
